comments.author: freediver
comments.story: Iconoclast: a Gothic/Cyberpunk MUD RPG, Online Since 1996
comments.why: Documentary for fans of MUDs and text adventures.
comments.text: Oh the MUDs! Props to Forest’s edge and TempusMUD. Text is the ultimate medium because it directly connects with our imagination. I remember jumping out of my chair after reading a line of text on my screen. Recommend watching “Get lamp” documentary to fans of MUDs, text adventures and those born after: [VIDEO]

comments.author: Eremotherium
comments.text: He also gave us the brilliant BBS: The Documentary [LINK] GET LAMP: The Text Adventure Documentary (shot in 1080p) [VIDEO] and (apart from his many talks) his podcast "Jason Scott talks his way out of it" which is just gem after gem of documented tech ephemera. [LINK] It's baffingly hard to quantify how many people he (and all the other great people at the Internet Archive) has affected with his bullheaded conservation efforts.
